derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G1587 (ἐκλείπω);
def: not left out, i.e. (by implication) inexhaustible

occurrences.text: Sell that ye have, and give alms; provide yourselves bags which wax not old, a treasure in the heavens that faileth not, where no thief approacheth, neither moth corrupteth.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
